description: Public staging deployment template. This is not wrangler configuration. Supply the reviewed artifact SHA and exact owner allowlist through authorized deployment controls; MCP stays disabled and identities denied by default.

existing_registry.instruction: Preserve this namespace for the existing staging Worker. Omit migrations on ordinary subsequent uploads; never recreate or delete the registry as rollback.

custom_domain_instruction: Inspect ownership/conflicts before creating a missing hostname. The API environment value production selects this staging Worker's default slot; it does not promote MTerm to production.

access.instruction: Keep the dashboard behind its existing exact-owner Access policy. The Worker independently validates signed Access JWT issuer/audience/expiry and its nonempty ALLOWED_EMAILS allowlist. Never use a wildcard or bypass policy.

temporary_test_identity.instruction: STAGING_SERVICE_ID is not a normal deployment binding. A separately authorized staging-only service identity may be used for acceptance and must be removed with its temporary policy/token after final proof.

first_recorded_good_smoke.instruction: Recovery reference, not an assertion of the current deployment. Review old binding values before rollback and keep temporary acceptance identities removed.
